original_question: Steve kpebiri na ọ ga-ebido riwekwuo tomato ma kpebie izu cherị tomato nke ya. Ọ na-eri ugboro abụọ karịa enyi ya nwaanyị. Ọ na-eri 6 kwa ụbọchị. Ọ bụrụ na ubi vaịn ga-amịpụta tomato 3 kwa izu ụka kedụ ubi vaịn ole o kwesịrị ị nwe?
question_template: {name_male, Steve} kpebiri na ọ ga-ebido riwekwuo tomato ma kpebie izu cherị tomato nke ya. Ọ na-eri {num_text_1, ugboro abụọ} karịa enyi ya nwaanyị. Ọ na-eri {num_digit_1, 6} kwa ụbọchị. Ọ bụrụ na ubi vaịn ga-amịpụta tomato {num_digit_2, 3} kwa izu ụka kedụ ubi vaịn ole o kwesịrị ị nwe?
question_solution: answer = (num_digit_1 * (1 + 1/f1) * 7) / num_digit_2  # f1 is the numeric value of num_text_1
